items.title: Synthetic helpdesk export, October 2026
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture. October 2026 support tickets: 1240 total; 471 tagged billing. Median first response for billing tickets 31 hours; for other tickets 9 hours.

items.title: Synthetic staffing note
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture. Two agents are trained on billing; both work weekday day shifts only. Billing questions that arrive on Friday after 15:00 wait until Monday.

items.title: Synthetic constraints note
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture. No new support headcount before 2027-01-01. Tooling budget for Q4 2026 is 3000 USD.

not_available.detail: No CSAT survey runs on billing tickets.
Nobody has counted how many billing questions a reply macro could answer.
